newsitem.title: USA: PaineWebber expands mutual fund portability.
newsitem.headline: PaineWebber expands mutual fund portability.

text.p: PaineWebber Inc and Smith Barney, a unit of Travelers Group Inc, said on Thursday that the brokerages have agreed to establish reciprocal portability of their proprietary mutual funds.
This will allow the brokerages' clients to retain ownership of proprietary mutual fund family shares if a client transfers accounts between the two firms, the companies said.

Before this type of agreement was made, a client who wished to retain ownership of a proprietary mutual fund after leaving a brokerage firm would have had to become a client of a transfer agent and lose the full-service of the brokerage.
